node: HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers below memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM / advanced-packaging sub-supplier node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane is intentionally light; the main candidates are specialized equipment, test, inspection/metrology, and bonding suppliers that sit one layer below memory producers, foundries, OSATs, and AI accelerator customers. Strongest directly evidenced exposure in this pass: FORM probe cards for HBM/advanced packaging and CAMT inspection/metrology with disclosed HBM-manufacturer orders. KLIC and AEHR are included as underfollowed hypotheses tied to thermo-compression bonding and AI/HBM package burn-in economics, respectively; both require customer and HBM-specific revenue verification before surviving later layers.
